text:
Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models, Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4, on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. This dual-model strategy was designed to address different market segments with specific pricing structures: Opus 4 served as the flagship model priced at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, while Sonnet 4 acted as a "fast workhorse" developer-default coding model priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens [Source: ev-1].

The launch signaled that agentic coding had become a defining product category for 2025, driven by the rise of Claude Code [Source: ev-1]. By positioning Claude 4 as the "safest and most reliable coding agent," Anthropic highlighted its competitive advantage in reliability; specifically, the new "computer use 2.0" feature was roughly twice as reliable as the previous generation's capabilities [Source: ev-1].
